label: Whatever has received esse is given being by something whenever it is present
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (concurrent actualization, weak version): in every history of the model, whatever has its esse received in some principle (EsseReceivedIn x z, DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN: a principle standing to it as receiving potency to received act; the act/potency sense of 'not its own being') is, at every moment t at which it is present, given being at t by something (GivesAt v g x t for some g, the primitive of definition 158301bc, on its STRICT esse-giving reading; on the inclusive reading, which also counts causing coming to be, the premise would be weaker than the reply it types). Scope: its antecedent is slightly broader than Feser's 'contingent thing' (esse received in SOME principle, not necessarily the thing's own essence), and 'present' rather than 'in act', the two being connected by presence-in-act 140544c4. The giver is not required to be God, unique, or non-temporal. Meaning: remaining in received act at a moment is itself an actualization at that moment and needs an actual actualizer then; it combines the actualization principle (a potency is brought to act only by something in act) with the contested thesis that continuing in received act is, at each moment, a potency being actualized; the premise does not type them separately. Analogies for the time profile only: the illumination of the air, which lasts only while the sun acts (ST I q.104 a.1 co.), and a stone held aloft; light is not esse, so carrying the profile from illumination to being presupposes the crux. Counterexamples the inertialist offers (a persisting rock, the water in a glass) are the rival account, not established cases. No case is on file of a received-esse thing persisting with no giver, and none of a received-esse thing given being at a later moment either. Structure: per moment (for each t some giver), not one giver at every moment; the giver need not be a tenseless cause of being, and may be the thing itself (the strong version excludes that). The adopted InPotency is not used, since DEF-POTENCY makes potency exclude act in the same respect, which would empty the premise under presence-in-act. The target of existential inertia (Schmid 2021, read): in its typed shape (Control part 1) a received-esse thing persists with nothing giving it being. Entailed by its strong version (registered strength order).
